title: GitHub Actions workflow 的 DAG 分析：拓扑排序、并行层、关键路径、环检测（实测）
expected_output:
[解析] workflow 名=ci 触发=['push', 'pull_request'] 任务数=5
[拓扑序] build -> lint -> test -> package -> deploy
[并行层] 层1=build,lint  层2=test  层3=package  层4=deploy
[关键路径] 长度=4 路径=build -> test -> package -> deploy
[环检测] 正常 workflow 环=None
[环检测] 环形 workflow 拓扑序=None 环成员=['a', 'b', 'c'] -> workflow 非法，GitHub 会直接拒绝
[判定] DAG 分析：正例无环=True 反例检出环=True
